--  Notes:- Removed Lower from natco_code as there is no value in caps
--  Internalemployee filter is always no only in whole dataset so removing additional filters
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
         DATE(event_date) AS dt
        ,event_date as date
        ,session_id
        ,service_line
        ,action
        ,guest_id
        ,label
        ,lower(page_name) as page_name
        ,order_id
	  
    FROM silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE 
        {{date}}
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(ui_page_category) = lower({{servie_line}})
        )
        AND natco_code = 'de'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR lower(user_device_type) = lower({{os_naame}})
        )	
        AND lower(category) <> 'addonmanagement'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{category}})
            OR category = {{category}}
            OR LOWER(category) = {{category}}
        )
        [[ AND {{natco}} ]]
),
base_period AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        date_trunc(
            CASE 
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily'   THEN 'day'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly'  THEN 'week'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN 'month'
            END,
            dt
        ) AS period_sort,
        CASE 
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily' THEN
                format_datetime(dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    format_datetime(date_trunc('week', dt), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
                    ' -Wk',
                    CAST(week_of_year(dt) AS VARCHAR)
                )
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN
                format_datetime(date_trunc('month', dt), 'MMM-yyyy')
        END AS period
    FROM base
),
onecheckout AS (
    SELECT
        period_sort,
        period,
        service_line,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS onecheckout_initiated
    FROM base_period
    WHERE lower(action) = 'onecheckoutinitiated'
    GROUP BY period_sort, period, service_line
),
orders AS (
    SELECT
        period_sort,
        period,
        service_line,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS order_placed
    FROM base_period
    WHERE lower(action) = 'purchasesuccess'
    GROUP BY period_sort, period, service_line
)
SELECT
    o.period,
    o.service_line,
    o.order_placed,
    oc.onecheckout_initiated,
    ROUND(o.order_placed * 1.0 / NULLIF(oc.onecheckout_initiated, 0), 3) AS conversion_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN onecheckout oc
    ON o.period_sort = oc.period_sort
    AND o.service_line = oc.service_line
ORDER BY o.period_sort, o.service_line;
